speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Seven of us. I did not send for anyone. If this is an agreement, it agreed itself.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I did not propose it. The hill ended at a door I know.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Nor mine. A roast capon is a reason that arrives after the door, not before it.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Lamb's-wool. The apples are already bursting in it. I am not going to improve a bowl by talking about it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then eat, and then let me have the table. I have held a story since the hall, and this is the inn.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: You may have it. Nobody threatens to go to the Admiral's. I will hear the story if the telling is the story, and not a second search.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Half an hour was the search. A story may be longer than a search. It may not be longer than the bowl.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Before the story, the book. My lord's purse on this leaf. The Queen's three nights on this one. Received, and expected. I will not be teased across the gutter between them.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Call it hose and have done. Four pounds, eight parts of ten shillings, and a morning. One leaf would hold the memory.

speaker: john_heminges
text: One leaf would lie. The ten shillings in your purse is my lord's. The three nights are not in your purse. An office is empty. Empty is the reason.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not arguing it. My ten is still in my purse.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: A gutter is a kindness when the gutter is money.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Let him tell it. He can have spoons if he wants actors, and he cannot have us as a chorus.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A gold button, five pearls in it, gone from a kirtle since the play began. Sam had a short candle. His hand came up rosemary. Nothing glinted.

speaker: will_kemp
text: The yeomen had tapers. I am doing those tapers in spoons, because a spoon is what this table has got.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I said, aside, that a little gold thing may raise a bigger search than a missing player ever did. John told me to keep it until the inn. This is the inn.

speaker: john_heminges
text: You have told it. It does not go into the book, and it does not become a share.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He searched half an hour. Nothing glinted. If the story finds the button, the story is a lie.

speaker: will_kemp
text: The story does not find it. Five pearls, and all of them still missing. The button stays lost.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Sam is not in this house. Leave him out of the spoons. He searched. He is done.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Tell it sitting down. A standing clown makes a room into a yard, and this is not a yard.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: There is a thing every man at this table has in his mouth.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Not at this board.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then not. I have the apples.

speaker: george_bryan
text: It is nearly four. Two hundred yards is not a reason to grow roots under a bench.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: At four we are in the street.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I have told it at length. The spoons may go back to being spoons. I am not adding a moral.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No moral. Out by four. My ten shillings is still in my purse, and still not counted against the rest.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The book shuts. Two leaves. I will hear of it if any of you tells me tomorrow that I agreed they were one.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Nobody heard that agreement. I will walk as far as the parting of the ways, and no farther into any man's house.
